tests.requirement: Electrical components in OXYGEN RICH ENVIRONMENT provided with power supplies having limited energy levels lower than those considered sufficient for ignition, as determined by examination, measurement or calculation of power, energy, and temperatures in NORMAL and SINGLE FAULT CONDITIONS

Max oxygen concentration measured until it did not exceed 25% in ventilated compartments with parts that can be a source of ignition only in SINGLE FAULT CONDITION and can be penetrated by oxygen due to an undetected leak

A compartment with parts or components that can be a source of ignition only under SINGLE FAULT CONDITION separated from another compartment containing an OXYGEN RICH ENVIRONMENT by sealing all joints and holes for cables, shafts, or other purposes

Effect of possible leaks and failures under SINGLE FAULT CONDITION that could cause ignition evaluated using a RISK ASSESSMENT to determine maintenance intervals by examination of documentation and RISK MANAGEMENT FILE
tests.result: Not used in conjunction with oxygen rich environments

semantic_fragments.content: All clauses 11.2.2.1 through 11.2.3 related to OXYGEN RICH ENVIRONMENTS are marked N/A with the remark 'Not used in conjunction with oxygen rich environments.' This indicates the device (PT9L) is not intended or designed for use in oxygen-rich environments, and therefore all associated fire/ignition risk requirements under these clauses are not applicable.

Clause 11.3 (Constructional requirements for fire ENCLOSURES) is marked as PASS (P). The ME EQUIPMENT met requirements for alternate means of compliance with selected HAZARDOUS SITUATIONS and fault conditions in 13.1.2. Constructional requirements were met or specifically analysed in RISK MANAGEMENT FILE. Specific sub-items under 11.3 a) and 11.3 b) regarding flammability classifications and enclosure openings are marked N/A, with physical observations noted: 'No openings at bottom' and 'No openings on the sides.'
